section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study involving a radar simulation. Participants, referred to as trainees, were randomly assigned to one of eight experimental conditions based on goal frame (learning vs. performance), goal content (learning vs. performance), and goal proximity (proximal vs. distal). The procedure involved a demonstration, studying an online manual, a trial period, nine cycles of study, practice, and feedback, and a final 10-minute generalization task that was more difficult.
